findings.trigger: run_gamut::<DisplayP3> local stack allocation shrank from 0x58 to 0x48 after the header println simplification
findings.sensitive_operation: hue_data returns a 104-byte f64 HueData by value; hot cache hit copies it with overlapping 64-byte stores to the stack and then reloads fields
findings.mechanism: stack alignment changes store-to-load forwarding conflicts on Ryzen 9800X3D native AVX-512 build
findings.causal_intervention: Only two frame-size immediate bytes changed in each original binary; code and static-data addresses preserved
findings.recommended_change: Return a shared reference to the cached hue entry, preserving lazy initialization; scratch prototype only

full_harness.protocol: 8 sequential processes in forward/reverse variant order, CPU 2, ASLR disabled, same /tmp/gma-dualray-c_nkcyap/timed-bench pathname, --in-gamut-check; 35640 grid and random inputs, 50 warmup/25 measured passes, all outputs consumed; no concurrent builds/tests/benchmarks

focused_probe.protocol: dlopen original executable with only DF_1_PIE removed; invoke existing closure with reconstructed context and preallocated cache/input. Copying code to a new mapping adjusts only external RIP-relative/relative displacements. Call wrapper aligns stack to 64 bytes then applies 0/16/32/48-byte offsets. Separate sequential processes pinned to CPU 2, ASLR disabled; 50 warmups after one checksum/init pass, 100 measured passes; check every checksum. No hot code recompiled except borrow prototype.

perf.scope: Process-wide hardware counters for focused grid probe; 1 initial pass + 50 warmup + 700 measured passes, plus loader/setup/teardown. Six simultaneous events, 100% running, one run each; counters corroborate, do not replace paired timing evidence.
perf.sample_ip_caveat: Raw PMU sampling is imprecise; do not assign every event to the sampled instruction or claim a particular undocumented hardware forwarding rule.

compatibility.scope: Display-P3, all 13 methods, both precisions and modes; same 136960-input manifest as milestone-3 report

limitations: Findings scoped to the native target-cpu build on this Ryzen 9800X3D; no portable x86-64, other CPU or JavaScript performance claim.
Prototype timing is a focused closure probe. Adoption still merits full all-target/precision/mode timing and portable validation.
Code-placement sweep was an initial diagnostic; the decisive original-binary frame patch preserves code and data placement.
Only the stack-size patch changes were made to executable copies; unwind metadata was not changed, and these panic-abort diagnostic copies are not production artifacts.
